name: Stygian-Cairn
description: Glacier upon glacier, blue-white and creaking, buried in places by nitrogen snow. The shell is broken in places by a subterranean ocean, and through those breaches the deep ocean breathes plumes of frost into the dark.
With no air to speak of, silence is total, broken only by whatever touches your boots. The horizon stays razor-sharp at any distance.
Surveyors date the derelict space station in orbit to before the region's last cataclysm, which should be impossible. The structures are unweathered, as if time skipped this place.
The next expedition is already fitting out. Whether it returns with data, ore, or just debts depends on choices nobody has made yet.
